pitch.title: The release gate for AI agents
pitch.body: Know if an agent change is safe to ship before your users find out.

run.title: Run any agent on real benchmarks
run.body: Coding, browser, voice, tools and more, on tasks you can trust.

bifrost.title: Every model call through Bifrost
bifrost.body: One gateway for cost, faults and a full trace of each call.

sealed.title: Verdicts you can trust
sealed.body: Sealed evidence behind every pass, fail and regression.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to run and review your agents.
login.judgeBody: Use the judge account email and password from the submission notes.

quickstart.title: Get started
quickstart.subtitle: Four commands from your repo to a release verdict.

steps.init: Detects your tests, agents and Docker, then writes .heimdall/.
steps.mine: Turns past commits into tasks your agent must solve.
steps.compare: Runs both versions side by side and prints the verdict.
steps.ci: Adds a GitHub check that comments on every pull request.

quickstart.minedSubtitle: Review drafted instructions before you trust the results.
